paras: Sceloporus halli, also known commonly as Hall's spiny lizard and la espinosa de Hall in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, halli, is in honor of biologist William Purington Hall III (born 1939).
S. halli is found in the Mexican state of Oaxaca.
The preferred natural habitat of S. halli is shrubland.
